description_excerpt: POSITION SUMMARY • Work with Area Head of Local Product & Operations and Procurement to set the strategic direction for Supplier Management. • Responsible to manage our supplier performance and compliance, make sure that on time delivery, visibility elements, capacity, split of volumes, payments and other mutual obligations are safeguarded and delivery as contracted. • Structure, staff and manage the Area supplier Management team to run the delivery business efficiently in accordance with defined product commitments. • Lead the supplier management team on Maersk’s transformation journey…
